question: Will the World Health Organization prequalify moxidectin before December 15, 2026?

calls.reasoning: As of 2026-10-31 moxidectin does not appear on the WHO PQ finished-pharmaceutical-products list and no PQ news item mentions it; ~6 weeks remain. WHO added moxidectin to the NTD EOI in Oct 2024 and issued BE guidance Apr 2026, so a pathway is open, and GiveWell (June 2024) estimated 80% PQ by end-2026, but there is no public sign of dossier acceptance or imminent decision, and the process has taken 2 years so far. Base rate for an unannounced PQ landing in a specific 6-week window is low; SRA-abridged pathway (FDA-approved innovator) keeps it from being negligible. No human market found.
